tools.name: zeffy_list_payments
tools.description: List donations, tickets and other payments for the organization, newest first, with optional filters. Each record carries line items, buyer and fund. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/payments.

tools.name: zeffy_get_payment
tools.description: Get one payment by id, with its items, refunds, dispute state and receipt link. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/payments/{id}.

tools.name: zeffy_list_contacts
tools.description: List donor and contact records, with totals and first and last donation dates. Filter by exact email or by created and updated time. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/contacts.

tools.name: zeffy_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id: name, email, phone, address, donor type, total contribution and donation dates. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: zeffy_list_campaigns
tools.description: List fundraising campaigns (donation forms, events, memberships, stores, raffles) with type, status, goal and volume. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/campaigns.

tools.name: zeffy_get_campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign by id: title, status, goal, volume, currency, dates, questions and rates. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: zeffy_list_users
tools.description: List the users (team members) of the organization with their role and status. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: zeffy_get_user
tools.description: Get one organization user by id: name, email, role and status. Zeffy API: GET /api/v1/users/{id}.

tools.name: zeffy_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the organization. Fails with a conflict when a contact with this email already exists; use zeffy_upsert_contact to update instead. Needs the organization's Stripe verification. Zeffy API: POST /api/v1/contacts.

tools.name: zeffy_upsert_contact
tools.description: Create the contact with this email, or update it when it exists. Safe to repeat with the same input. Needs the organization's Stripe verification. Zeffy API: PUT /api/v1/contacts.

tools.name: zeffy_update_contact
tools.description: Change the name, phone or address of an existing contact by id. Only the fields you send change. Needs the organization's Stripe verification. Zeffy API: PATCH /api/v1/contacts/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zeffy_list_payments, zeffy_list_contacts, zeffy_get_contact, zeffy_get_user · Private data: zeffy_list_payments, zeffy_list_contacts, zeffy_get_contact, zeffy_create_contact, zeffy_upsert_contact, zeffy_update_contact · Public sink: zeffy_list_contacts, zeffy_get_contact, zeffy_get_user, zeffy_create_contact, zeffy_upsert_contact, zeffy_update_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zeffy_list_payments, zeffy_list_contacts, zeffy_get_contact, zeffy_get_user · Private data: zeffy_list_payments, zeffy_list_contacts, zeffy_get_contact, zeffy_create_contact, zeffy_upsert_contact, zeffy_update_contact · Public sink: zeffy_list_contacts, zeffy_get_contact, zeffy_get_user, zeffy_create_contact, zeffy_upsert_contact, zeffy_update_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
